hero.title: Creative
hero.intro: Pixel Graphics is an independent creative studio combining strategy, design and social media to help businesses build brands people remember.

paragraphs: Pixel Graphics is a fully remote creative studio based in Suriname. We work with brands around the world on branding, graphic design, social media and content strategy.
Working online means no office overhead and no borders. You get direct contact with the people designing your brand, through WhatsApp, email or video call.
Our rule is simple: every design must help you get seen, trusted and chosen.

cards.title: Why we started
cards.text: Pixel Graphics was founded in Suriname with one belief: great design should not depend on where you are. We started as a fully remote studio so growing businesses everywhere could get professional creative support, without the cost and slowness of a traditional agency.

cards.title: Make brands stand out
cards.text: We help businesses get seen, trusted and chosen. Through strategic design, clear content and consistent social media, we turn brands into something people recognise, remember and want to work with.

cards.title: Borderless creativity
cards.text: To become the creative partner brands around the world trust, proving that a remote studio from Suriname can create work that competes on a global stage.

values.title: What we
values.intro: Six principles that shape how we design, communicate and collaborate.

items.title: Creative thinking
items.text: Fresh ideas grounded in what your business actually needs.

items.title: Professional communication
items.text: Clear updates, honest timelines and fast replies.

items.title: Global collaboration
items.text: Comfortable working across countries, cultures and time zones.

items.title: Flexible remote workflow
items.text: Online meetings, shared files and structured feedback rounds.

items.title: Attention to detail
items.text: Every pixel, colour and word checked before delivery.

items.title: Strategic design
items.text: Design decisions that support your goals, not just look good.

items.title: One studio, every visual
items.text: Branding, graphic design, social media and content strategy, all under one roof. Your brand looks and sounds the same everywhere, because it all comes from one team.

items.title: Clear scope, clear price
items.text: Hourly rates, monthly packages or a personal quote. You know exactly what you get and what it costs, before we start.

items.title: Global by default
items.text: We work fully online, in English, with clients wherever they are. Time zones are a planning detail, not a problem.

items.title: Built to be consistent
items.text: Every design follows your brand identity, so every post, flyer and package feels unmistakably like you.

remote.title: Our remote
remote.intro: Working remotely doesn't mean working at a distance. Here's how we keep collaboration personal and organised.

items.title: Online meetings
items.text: Kick-offs, presentations and check-ins via Google Meet, Zoom, Teams or WhatsApp.

items.title: Shared files
items.text: One clear project brief and one shared folder, so everything stays in one place.

items.title: Clear feedback
items.text: Structured review rounds with all feedback combined. No endless email threads.

items.title: Any time zone
items.text: We plan meetings and deadlines around your time zone, wherever you are.
